messages:
tasha: Noticed a parity bug: Node SDK retries on 429s without honoring Retry-After, while Python honors it. This is causing duplicate bursts from apps using our Node sample.

felix: Wow, that's bad. Any idea where Node's logic is different?

ryan: I dug in. Node's client has a simple retry loop with exponential backoff, but the code path that handles 429s didn't check `retry-after` header. It just applies backoffFactor * attempts.

cli-bot: Automated test run: samples/bulk-translate/node failed 3/10 retries with 429s. See CI job: https://ci.redwood.example/9876

tasha: We should standardize: SDKs must, by default, honor `Retry-After` if present and use it as the base wait time (then add jitter). Fallback to our exponential policy if header absent.

felix: Agreed. Also request we ship a small RateLimiter helper in both SDKs that supports: token-bucket rate (rps), concurrency limit (semaphore), and a paced async iterator for paginated endpoints. Many customers paste Promise.all + listPages() and blow quotas.

ryan: Proposal for the paginated helper (pseudo-Python):
```py
async def paced_pages(async_page_iter, min_interval=0.2, backoff_base=0.5):
    # yields pages but ensures we don't hammer the service
    async for page in async_page_iter:
        yield page
        await asyncio.sleep(min_interval)
```
This is simple but effective for background sync jobs.

tasha: For Node sample apps, let's default demo/demo keys to conservative limits (2 rps, concurrency 1) and print a one-line console warning: "Using demo key: operating in low-quota mode (2 rps)".

felix: Test plan: instrument sample apps to run in CI with a fake rate-limited endpoint and assert SDK waits at least `retry-after` seconds and respects concurrency caps. Add unit tests for jitter distribution so retries don't align.

ryan: Telemetry note: SDKs should emit an internal event `client.throttle.local` when a request is delayed by the client-side limiter. Keep it opt-out and anonymized. Helps us measure how many users rely on client-side throttling.

tasha: We also need docs: a short troubleshooting section for "Onboarding 429s" with three recipes: 1) use SDK RateLimiter, 2) paginate with paced iterator, 3) detect demo key and reduce defaults.

felix: Implementation owners: Node SDK (felix), Python SDK (ryan), samples update (tasha). Can we aim for a patch release next week?

cli-bot: Created issue RDW-5022: "SDK parity: Retry-After + client-side rate limiter" assigned to @felix and @ryan, priority P2. https://redwood.example/rdw/5022

tasha: Great, I'll draft the docs snippet and a tiny code example we can drop into quickstarts. Thanks! :sparkles:
